title: We Shall Be With the Lord

request.style: English, brass band funeral march, slow muffled drum, mournful euphoniums, horns and tubas, a quiet congregation singing in harmony, turning to a brighter major key at the end, dignified and hopeful, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We do not grieve as those
Who have no hope at all
For Jesus died and rose again
And he will raise them all

[Chorus]
And so we shall be with the Lord
Forever with the Lord
Encourage one another with these words
Forever with the Lord

[Verse]
The Lord himself will come
With the trumpet call of God
And those who sleep in Christ will rise
From underneath the sod

[Chorus]
And so we shall be with the Lord
Forever with the Lord
Encourage one another with these words
Forever with the Lord
